### Transcription Notes

* **Priest Signature:** Nearly every entry on the right page is signed off by the parish priest, **J. Bourke, P.P.** (Parish Priest).
* **Common Names:** The register shows a high concentration of classic Irish surnames (e.g., *Ryan, Bourke, Maher, Meagher, Cummins, Keating*), typical of mid-19th-century Irish parish records.
